items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 83:1
items.html: The source of the drop of the coupling that brings the bottom Hey down from the Einayim and annuls the Parsas is AB of AK, since it is above the second restriction. For the second restriction began from SAG of AK, as is known, and therefore the illumination of AB annuls the second restriction and all the screens that are drawn from its side.
